channel.title: Ar on IoTone, Inc.
channel.description: Recent content in Ar on IoTone, Inc.

item.title: Spectacles-polynode
item.description: The ‘missing’ web utility/core libraries for Snap Spectacles — SpaceCanvas, SpaceSVG, SpaceDOM, EventEmitter — backfills HTML5 platform APIs Lens Studio doesn’t ship.

item.title: Spectacles SkywriterBLE
item.description: BLE HID keyboard for Snap Spectacles, with a distraction-free XR word processor on top. 3rd Place OSS Prize, Lensfest April 2026.

item.title: MIDI Bleep Blop
item.description: A MIDI library and bridge that turns a Snap Spectacles lens into a controller for real hardware synths. #Lensfest May 2026 OSS, with a Tester Lens.

item.title: Spectacles NekoChan
item.description: A fully on-device Snap Spectacles lens: a 3D cat that shares facts — in Japanese — about native breeds and Japan’s cat islands. No internet, no experimental APIs.

item.title: Spectacles-Matematex
item.description: A LaTex parser and renderer for Snap Spectacles, for rendering math notation in AR.

item.title: Spectacles DeskWindow
item.description: Spatial desktop mirroring for Snap Spectacles — the first OSS solution for streaming a desktop into AR.

item.title: Snap Spectacles Interaction Kit Samples
item.description: Snap Spectacles Interaction Kit Samples designed as a building block for new lenses.

item.title: NekoChan — a fully-offline Japanese cat lens for Spectacles
item.description: Spectacles-NekoChan is a Snap Spectacles lens where a 3D cat shares facts — in Japanese — about native breeds and Japan’s cat islands, running entirely on-device with no internet and no experimental APIs.

item.title: MIDI Bleep Blop — perform on live synths from a Spectacles lens
item.description: A MIDI library and bridge so you can perform on live musical instruments from a Snap Spectacles lens — now with a Tester Lens you can try yourself. An IoTone, Inc. #Lensfest May 2026 OSS drop.

item.title: Spectacles SkywriterBLE — typing in AR
item.description: A BLE HID keyboard reference for Snap Spectacles, with a prototype word processor on top. Solves typing in AR.

item.title: Matrix WebSocket Bridge AR/XR adapter
item.description: An AR/XR UI wrapper around the Matrix WebSocket bridge.
